name: done-gate
post_title: Your Agent's "Done" Is a Self-Report. Make It a Predicate.
description: Runs a .done/<task>.json predicate file (decompose-epic's command, test, file_exists, glob_count plus file_absent, grep_count and unchanged_since) against the repo's end state: --hook exits 2 with failing predicates on stderr for a Claude Code Stop or SubagentStop hook, --ci exits 1 with a summary for a required status check, and lint flags prose criteria and exit-code predicates with no unchanged_since guard on the tests
